content: Lama eru siŋaŋyaŋuŋ fiine.

Yesuji siŋaŋ bobo buŋo iŋi miya, “Nonji buŋo foriine yobu mo iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Goineji lama jokoroŋ maŋineo ropeiŋ ore mendigo matayoŋ, sa kigaru rakagobi, yoŋoji suroŋqoqo eru kiaŋ bobo ŋiŋigo fukegobi.
Moji mendigo ropega, iŋoji lama yoŋore siŋaŋ fukega.

Iŋoji wapeme mendi siŋaŋineji oi ŋoneru mendi ro teko wakiru oŋgame lama yoŋoji buŋo maruine soine mane mukuegobi. Siŋaŋyaŋunji iŋoyoŋunde lamapu oga yaberu tinayaŋuŋ oŋgaku oga yabeme jokoroŋyaŋuŋ bokeru soine sakibe raegobi.
“Iŋoyoŋunde lamapu sosowo oga yabeme jokoroŋyaŋuŋ bokeru sakibe rabi iŋoji mineboboyaŋuŋ fukeru rone rako buŋo maruine mane mukugobi ore ŋadiineo boyoberu raegobi.
Yoŋoyaŋunde siŋaŋ soine boyobeegobiyoŋ, kotu moji wareru oŋgako oi so yobu boyobenimiŋ. Kotu yoŋore buŋo maru so mane mukugobi ore bio ruruine eru iŋore kokoi useru roiŋganimiŋ.”
Yesuji buŋo sumuŋine oi yajiyayoŋ, buŋo ore fuŋine so mane taniŋgaru qiqu qabuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuji lama siŋaŋ fiine fukega.
Qiqu qabi jikigaru yoŋore iŋi miya, “Nonji buŋo foriine yobu mo iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Nonji lama jokoronde mendi fukego.
Nonde ŋadio kubu siŋaŋ sosowo rone warebuŋ, yoŋoji suroŋqoqo eru kiaŋ bobo ŋiŋigo fukebuŋ. Oŋu fukebuŋ ore lama yoŋoji oi so mane muku yaberu gobuŋ.

“Nonji moakoŋ lama jokoronde mendi fukego. Uri yoŋoji Anutuke sanaŋgaru gokimiŋ ore miku noke qakatoru gobuŋ, nonji munaŋ qa yarebe qowirienimiŋ. Oŋu fukeru lama jokoroŋ maŋgo rope wakiru sakibe raru uqo kaeine moririineke bofukeenimiŋ.

Kiaŋ bobo yoŋoji wamore wareegobi? Yoŋoji kiaŋ roku noberu sibiri nobeiŋgo ore wareegobi. Ya furuine baiŋ ore mata. Nonji oŋuine so fukego. Nonji ŋoŋo gogo sanaŋine bofukeru seŋgiŋbaŋgiŋ gonimiŋ ore eru wareru gogo.
“Nonji lama siŋaŋ fiine fukego. Lama siŋaŋ fiineji lamapuine yoŋore eru gogoine kisiŋga yareiŋ.

Moji lama rauine so fukeru furiine banimiŋ ore akoŋ wareru jibu siŋaŋ yabeega, iŋo iŋi: Qoro rigaŋineji wareko ŋoneru lama boke yaberu totieru rako gomeŋ qoro rigaŋineji lama qomijie yaberu ki yabe boroiŋ yabeiŋ.
Iŋoji sakibeone wareru furi rorore akoŋ ‘Lama siŋaŋ yabebemiŋ,’ oi miineji miku lama yoŋore manemeja so eru keta paio jibu goku kamieru raiŋ.

“Nonji lama siŋaŋ fiine fukego. Mamaneji noŋ mane nuko nonji Mamane maneru gogo. Ore so nonji nakene lamapu mane yabebe yoŋoji noŋ mane nuegobi. Nonji gogone lamapune ŋoŋore ruaru kisiŋgaru bokebemiŋ.

Nonde lama kubu goine oi oŋuakoŋ fukeru gonimiŋ. Yoŋoji lama jokoroŋ yoore rau so gogobiyoŋ, jibu nonde buŋo maru maneenimiŋ. Nonji yoŋo oŋuakoŋ oga yabebe ore so raru wareenimiŋ. Jiki kubuine kubuine yoŋoji qodureru kubu sogo moakoŋ fukebi siŋaŋ moakonji siŋaŋ yabeme gonimiŋ.
“Mamaji iŋi ore eru noŋ manji jojoko enareega: Nonji gogone bokeru moke gboreru go ropebemiŋ. Oi Mamare jiŋoo sagaga.
Gogone moji so oga nuiŋyoŋ, oi nake kisiŋgaru bokebemiŋ. Mamaneji mitiga nareme nake gogone kisiŋgaru bokebemiŋ eru ore ŋadiineo moke gboreru go ropebemiŋ. Usuŋ oŋuine oi nondeo pega.”
Yesuji buŋo oi miya ore eru Juda minebobo yoŋore botugo noigoi moke fukeya.
Yoŋoreone kokoineji iŋi mibuŋ, “Gemoji maŋineo rakame goku witijibu ega. Niŋo wamore buŋoine manenobeŋ? Bio bokeinebeneŋ.”
Goineji mibi, “Buŋo oŋuine oi bapeboriŋ ŋire buŋo oŋuine mata. Gemoji jiŋokombi ŋiŋigo yoŋore jiŋo uruŋu botigana?” Oŋu mimane ebuŋ.
Juda minebobo yoŋoji Yesu ŋadi gabuŋ.
Ronekoŋ boji soriŋ keririkeru mendiine robuŋ. Oi gosa so manesuku kombande jeriekimiŋ ore
Jerusalem tumaŋgabuŋ. Damaŋ oo ware fukeme kueyoiko damaŋ munaŋinere maŋgo gobuŋ.
Yesuji boji sorinde jokoroŋ maŋgo kiŋ Solomonde kae jiŋo saraŋineke mibuŋ, oo raru roregaya.
Raru roregaru Juda minebobo yoŋoji wareru roregaru iŋi weu tebuŋ, “Fuŋnego kemagande damaŋ wojimu jikigaru odigakimiŋ ore manege? Go Munaŋqoqo Rauine fukege me mata, oi totogo minde manekimiŋ.”
Oŋu miku weu tebi Yesuji iŋi bokirie yareya, “Noŋ mibe manebuŋyoŋ, ŋoŋo nonde buŋo oi so manesiŋ gagobi. Nonji Mamanere tinao mosi qoqowirie eego, oiji fuŋnene barariŋgaru kitiŋgaku ŋaduega.
Oi kitiŋgaku ŋaduegayoŋ, ŋoŋo nonde lama kubu maŋineo so gogobi ore eru buŋone so manesiŋ gaegobi.
“Nonji lamapune mane yabebe yoŋoji oŋuakoŋ nonde buŋo maru maneru noŋ boyobe nuegobi.
Nonji gogo sanaŋine yarebe qowirieru damaŋ mogo so yobu sibiriganimiŋ. Moji mo oi nonde meone so poreru ketotie yabeiŋ.
Nonde Mamaji yoŋo nonde meo rua yabeya, iŋoji sosowo yadureru ropekiine fukega. Ore eru sosowoji yoŋo nonde Mamare meone poreru ketotie yabenimiŋ ore embimbiŋganimiŋ.
Noŋ eru Mama nikoji moakoŋ fukeru gogobere.”
Yesuji oŋu miko Juda minebobo yoŋo moke moreŋgone ko amegaru oiji bokeru qaiŋgo ebuŋ.
Oŋu ebuŋyoŋ, iŋi miyareya, “Mamaji maŋgo enareko mosi qoqowirie yasogo kokoine eba ebe ŋonebuŋ, yoŋoreone wamo ya more manesuku noŋ koji bokeru nuiŋgo manegobi?”

Mi yareko Juda yoŋoji kerisieru mibuŋ, “Niŋoji mosi qoqowirie soguine emeŋ ore eru so koji bokeru guiŋgo egobeneŋyoŋ, Anutu igosisi etege ore geo egarekimiŋ. Go moreŋ ŋi eru sakigo mo ba ropeku Anutu oŋuine fukeiŋ ore mige.”
Oŋu mibi Yesuji bokirie yareya, “Biŋe Quraŋgo Kadi buŋo mo iŋi quraŋgame pega, ‘Anutu nonji mibe: Ŋoŋo nonde apa ŋasopu fukegobi.’
Biŋe Qurande buŋo oi so jaŋgaru mataeiŋyoŋ, sanaŋ qaŋqaŋine peiŋ. Ore eru Anutuji buŋoine ruame wareru ŋiŋigo biŋeyaŋuŋ fukeya, Anutuji yoŋore tina ‘apa ŋasopune’ oŋu miyareya.

Ŋiŋigo omaine oŋu miyareyayoŋ, Mamaji ŋi bagbagbagaru soreme moreŋgo wakiya, ŋoŋoji uruŋu eku iŋore iŋi migobi, ‘Go Anutu igosisi eteku goge.’ Nonji ‘Anuture made fukego,’ buŋo oŋu mibe ŋoŋoji wamore oi manebi so sagaga? Ŋoŋo Anuture Biŋe buŋo oi qagobi me?
“Gio baego, oi ŋonebi Mamanere eebobore so, so fukeega ine, ŋoŋo so manesiŋ nuniŋ.

Mamanere eebobore so eba eku gogo ine, fuŋnene oŋuine ŋoneru manesiŋ nuinebi. Oi buŋonere eru so manesiŋ ganobuŋ ine, mosi qoqowirienere eru jibu manesiŋ nuinebi. Mamaji noke qakatoru dimaga eru nonji Mamake qakatoru dimago, ŋoŋo ore fuŋine mane muku sariganimiŋ ore yo migo.”
Yesuji oŋu miko moke roru nigiŋgaiŋgo manebuŋyoŋ, me yukuyaŋuŋgo qopogaru wakiru raya.
Boke yaberu Jordan obu fusiine petigaru moke aribe raru Jonji rone miti meso rau yareru goya, oo roperu damaŋ goine jikigaru oo goya.
Oo goko ŋiŋigo kokoineji iŋoreo wareru ŋoneru iŋi mibuŋ, “Jonji mosi qoqowirie moakoŋ mo so eyayoŋ, buŋo sosowo ŋi yo ore miya, oi buŋo foriine miku goya.”
Warebuŋ, yoŋoreone kokoineji maŋyaŋuŋ kerisieru manesiŋ gabuŋ. Oŋu.
